name: subnets
description: One mod per Bittensor subnet (subnets.sn<N>) — identity, market, 24h flow and news, regenerated once a day by cron from the local orbit/bt index. No third-party APIs, no keys; every subnet mod still answers from its snapshot when bt is down.
cron: 41 5 * * * mod.py sync  (# subnets daily mod sync)
